performance_issues.description: All commits are loaded into memory via ShowPrettyFormatLogToList before pagination is applied
performance_issues.impact: For PRs with thousands of commits, all are loaded into memory even if only one page is requested
performance_issues.recommendation: Use git log with --skip and -n for server-side pagination

optimization_recommendations.description: Use git log --skip/--max-count for server-side pagination instead of loading all commits
